quillpup.name: Quillpup
quillpup.blurb: A bristled hound. Family leftover. Hits like a thrown crate.

glimmoth.name: Glimmoth
glimmoth.blurb: Lantern-gut moth of the tall grass. Burns what it blesses.

tortcask.name: Tortcask
tortcask.blurb: A walking cask of moss and stubbornness.

razorbat.name: Razorbat
razorbat.blurb: Camp-bred cutter. Hunts by the whistle of its wings.

mossback.name: Mossback
mossback.blurb: A toad in a coat of wet leaves. Absorbs what it sits on.

briarfox.name: Briarfox
briarfox.blurb: Thorn-pelt fox of the deep trees. Fast, and it bites last.

fenwisp.name: Fenwisp
fenwisp.blurb: A lantern soul of the wet trees. It burns cold.

duskhorn.name: Duskhorn
duskhorn.blurb: A rust-horned ram of the deep wood. It charges first.

needleroot.name: Needleroot
needleroot.blurb: A walking thorn-stump. Slow, and it drinks blood from cuts.

cathleen.name: Cathleen
cathleen.blurb: A sentient CryMon. She fights as herself, in a red hood.

crymare.name: CryMare
crymare.blurb: A grave-horse of fog. It screams in a voice that isn't a horse.

frostail.name: Frostail
frostail.blurb: Ice-fox. Its tail is a frozen blade.

boulderam.name: Boulderam
boulderam.blurb: A ram of granite and moss.

thornhide.name: Thornhide
thornhide.blurb: A boar armored in living thorns.

glasswisp.name: Glasswisp
glasswisp.blurb: A floating prism of living glass.

ashenmaw.name: Ashenmaw
ashenmaw.blurb: A wolf of cinder and glowing ribs.

heavenfall.name: Heavenfall
heavenfall.blurb: A meteor that learned to open its eye.

peatling.name: Peatling
peatling.blurb: A sod-clump pup. It sneezes marsh water.

mireback.name: Mireback
mireback.blurb: Peatling grown into a bog-hide beast. Steps become sinkholes.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.blurb: A walking mushroom. The cap is a wet lantern.

slatekin.name: Slatekin
slatekin.blurb: A chip of quarry stone that learned to scuttle.

gravelurk.name: Gravelurk
gravelurk.blurb: A crouched pile of quarry grit. It waits, then it is a wall.

cindermite.name: Cindermite
cindermite.blurb: A kiln-bug. Heat leaks from the joints.

veilcap.name: Veilcap
veilcap.blurb: Glowcap grown into a hanging lantern. Spore-veils drip light.

kilnback.name: Kilnback
kilnback.blurb: Cindermite plated in kiln-slag. Heat walks on six legs.

lead.name: Lieutenant Lead
lead.blurb: A Weeping Army officer who fights with steel, not crystals.

shrewbit.name: Shrewbit
shrewbit.blurb: A field shrew that never stops moving. It bites the ankle and is gone.

jolthare.name: Jolthare
jolthare.blurb: A hare that stores static in its fur. Touch it and your hair stands up.

voltbuck.name: Voltbuck
voltbuck.blurb: Jolthare grown antlers of forked lightning. The ground rings when it runs.

chillnewt.name: Chillnewt
chillnewt.blurb: A marsh newt with frost on its back. The water freezes where it sleeps.

rimewyrm.name: Rimewyrm
rimewyrm.blurb: Chillnewt grown long and cold. Its breath leaves the reeds white.

runemote.name: Runemote
runemote.blurb: A mote of old writing that drifted off a ruin wall. It hums the word it was.

glyphwing.name: Glyphwing
glyphwing.blurb: Runemotes that found each other and learned to fly. Each feather is a spell.

scavrat.name: Scavrat
scavrat.blurb: A camp rat fat on stolen rations. It is braver than most of the soldiers.

plunderat.name: Plunderat
plunderat.blurb: Scavrat grown to the size of a dog. It wears a helmet it took off a dead man.

stardrop.name: Stardrop
stardrop.blurb: A pebble of fallen star that grew legs. It glows brightest right before it hits you.

rimeowl.name: Rimeowl
rimeowl.blurb: A white owl of the high cliffs. Its hoot leaves frost on the rocks.

voltgrub.name: Voltgrub
voltgrub.blurb: A quarry grub that eats copper ore. It sparks when you step near it.

charmkin.name: Charmkin
charmkin.blurb: A thumb-sized fae of the grove. It trades luck for shiny things.

sparkit.name: Sparkit
sparkit.blurb: A kitten that sheds sparks when it purrs. Keep it off the hay.

blazelynx.name: Blazelynx
blazelynx.blurb: Sparkit grown lean and tufted with flame. It stalks by firelight.

pyrelion.name: Pyrelion
pyrelion.blurb: A lion with a mane of open fire. It roars and the grass goes black.

frostfry.name: Frostfry
frostfry.blurb: A minnow with ice for scales. It swims in puddles that should have melted.

floepike.name: Floepike
floepike.blurb: Frostfry grown long and toothy. It hunts under the ice and waits.

glacierjaw.name: Glacierjaw
glacierjaw.blurb: A pike the size of a boat. Its bite freezes what it does not tear.

pipsprout.name: Pipsprout
pipsprout.blurb: A seed that learned to walk before it learned to grow.

vinebrute.name: Vinebrute
vinebrute.blurb: Pipsprout grown into a knot of vines with fists.

rootking.name: Rootking
rootking.blurb: An old tree that walks the paths it once shaded. Birds follow it.

dustmole.name: Dustmole
dustmole.blurb: A blind mole that sneezes grit. It finds you by your footsteps.

tunneler.name: Tunneler
tunneler.blurb: Dustmole grown claws like shovels. The ground caves in behind it.

quakelord.name: Quakelord
quakelord.blurb: A mole the size of a cart. When it stamps, the whole path shakes.

sparkfly.name: Sparkfly
sparkfly.blurb: A firefly that glows yellow and stings like a shock.

arcwasp.name: Arcwasp
arcwasp.blurb: Sparkfly grown a stinger that arcs. It never flies alone.

thunderqueen.name: Thunderqueen
thunderqueen.blurb: The mother of the hive. Her wings hum like a storm coming in.

soottick.name: Soottick
soottick.blurb: A tick black as soot. It drops from branches onto warm necks.

gloomspider.name: Gloomspider
gloomspider.blurb: Soottick grown eight long legs. Its webs catch light as well as flies.

widowshade.name: Widowshade
widowshade.blurb: A spider as big as a door. What it wraps does not come back.

cardkin.name: Cardkin
cardkin.blurb: A living playing card. It flips itself over to show you your luck.

fateweaver.name: Fateweaver
fateweaver.blurb: Cardkin shuffled into a spinning deck. It deals futures, mostly bad.

arcanox.name: Arcanox
arcanox.blurb: A beast of floating cards and old symbols. It reads you before it strikes.

mooncalf.name: Mooncalf
mooncalf.blurb: A pale calf born under a full moon. Its hide glows faintly.

moonbull.name: Moonbull
moonbull.blurb: Mooncalf grown horns shaped like a crescent. It charges at night.

eclipsaur.name: Eclipsaur
eclipsaur.blurb: A great beast with a black disc for a face. Stars go out when it looks up.

pipwren.name: Pipwren
pipwren.blurb: A tiny brown bird that follows travelers for crumbs.

kestrail.name: Kestrail
kestrail.blurb: Pipwren grown fast and sharp-eyed. It hangs in the wind before it dives.

grandroc.name: Grandroc
grandroc.blurb: A bird big enough to carry off a horse. It has done so.

tallowisp.name: Tallowisp
tallowisp.blurb: A candle flame with nothing holding it up. It gutters when you speak.

cryptlamp.name: Cryptlamp
cryptlamp.blurb: Tallowisp that moved into a tomb lantern. It lights the way down.

deathknell.name: Deathknell
deathknell.blurb: A black bell that rings itself. Whoever hears the third ring falls.

snowbell.name: Snowbell
snowbell.blurb: A bell of ice that rings in cold wind. Snow falls where it sings.

icecantor.name: Icecantor
icecantor.blurb: Snowbell grown a voice. It sings one high note that cracks glass.

frostchoir.name: Frostchoir
frostchoir.blurb: A floating ring of ice bells. Their song freezes the air solid.

rubblet.name: Rubblet
rubblet.blurb: A brick that fell off a tower and decided to keep going.

ramparth.name: Ramparth
ramparth.blurb: Rubblet grown into a wall that walks. It blocks paths on purpose.

towerfall.name: Towerfall
towerfall.blurb: A tower on legs. When it falls on something, that is the end of it.

boltlamb.name: Boltlamb
boltlamb.blurb: A lamb with static wool. Petting it is a mistake you make once.

thunderam.name: Thunderam
thunderam.blurb: Boltlamb grown curled horns that spark. It charges into storms.

clovercalf.name: Clovercalf
clovercalf.blurb: A calf with clover growing on its back. It eats its own coat.

gardenbull.name: Gardenbull
gardenbull.blurb: Clovercalf grown into a bull wearing a whole garden. Bees live on it.

twinklet.name: Twinklet
twinklet.blurb: Two tiny lights that always move together. Hit one and both flinch.

geminal.name: Geminal
geminal.blurb: Twinklet grown into two spirits joined at the hand. They argue in battle.

rimecrab.name: Rimecrab
rimecrab.blurb: A crab with a shell of frost. It walks sideways over frozen streams.

floeclaw.name: Floeclaw
floeclaw.blurb: Rimecrab grown a shell like a sheet of ice. One claw is much bigger.

scorchbeak.name: Scorchbeak
scorchbeak.blurb: A red chick whose beak is always hot. It burns what it pecks.

ashwing.name: Ashwing
ashwing.blurb: Scorchbeak grown into a hawk that leaves smoke behind it.

rockhermit.name: Rockhermit
rockhermit.blurb: A crab living in a hollow stone. It never comes out to talk.

cragsage.name: Cragsage
cragsage.blurb: Rockhermit grown old in a boulder. It knows things and keeps them.

grimkid.name: Grimkid
grimkid.blurb: A black goat kid with red eyes. It laughs like a person.

baphorn.name: Baphorn
baphorn.blurb: Grimkid grown huge, horned and upright. Candles light when it walks by.

tuftowl.name: Tuftowl
tuftowl.blurb: A small owl with ear tufts like a judge's wig. It stares until you look away.

magistowl.name: Magistowl
magistowl.blurb: Tuftowl grown grave and heavy. It weighs every creature it meets.

starfry.name: Starfry
starfry.blurb: A tiny fish that glows like a star. It swims in the sky on clear nights.

starwhale.name: Starwhale
starwhale.blurb: Starfry grown vast. It swims above the clouds and sings to the moon.

dawnchick.name: Dawnchick
dawnchick.blurb: A yellow chick that crows at sunrise and sparks when it does.

sunhawk.name: Sunhawk
sunhawk.blurb: Dawnchick grown into a hawk that flies straight at the sun.

reedfawn.name: Reedfawn
reedfawn.blurb: A fawn that hides in reeds. It springs away at any sound.

bowstag.name: Bowstag
bowstag.blurb: Reedfawn grown antlers like a drawn bow. It shoots thorns from them.

motley.name: Motley
motley.blurb: A grinning jester of many colors. It trips you and laughs about it.

sleightfox.name: Sleightfox
sleightfox.blurb: A fox that does card tricks. The card you picked is gone, and so is your purse.

moonveil.name: Moonveil
moonveil.blurb: A moth with wings like a silver veil. It only flies under a full moon.

bloomdoe.name: Bloomdoe
bloomdoe.blurb: A doe covered in flowers. Where it sleeps, the grass grows back.

warbison.name: Warbison
warbison.blurb: A huge bison with a crown of broken horns. It does not move for anyone.

gallowcrow.name: Gallowcrow
gallowcrow.blurb: A crow that sits on gallows. It laughs at the hanged.

gravemoth.name: Gravemoth
gravemoth.blurb: A gray moth that lands on the dying. It is always early.

hornblaze.name: Hornblaze
hornblaze.blurb: A red ram with horns like trumpets. Its call wakes the dead and sets fires.

atlashell.name: Atlashell
atlashell.blurb: A tortoise with a whole hill on its back. People have built on it.

tidewolf.name: Tidewolf
tidewolf.blurb: A blue wolf that howls at the moon and brings the cold tide in.

wheelhog.name: Wheelhog
wheelhog.blurb: A hedgehog that rolls into a sparking wheel and never stops.
